payout_cut.note: an explicit distribution cut (an ASSUMPTION, from the review of 2026-11-02): when the sticky rule's payout would put the yield on the smoothed price (4 D / Pbar) above multiple x the ticker's normal yield, the payout is cut back to the normal yield on Pbar. Without it the error correction is unstable above about 1.36 x normal for MPLX (gamma -0.10, normal 8.5%), 2.2 x for EPD and 2.7 x for MO, and the 2% price floor made a drained state (the whole value paid out every quarter) absorbing. The multiple is not estimated: the 2013-2026 sample has no BDC / MLP cut to fit it on.
